name: ghost-prompt
description: Ghost-text completions for your Copilot prompts — write faster, think clearer.
author: JaminSmoke

ghostPrompt.completionProvider.markdownDescription: Legacy single-backend switch used **only** when `ghostPrompt.enabledCompletionSources` has never been set in User or Workspace settings. Prefer **enabledCompletionSources** for Copilot + OpenCode together.

ghostPrompt.enabledCompletionSources.markdownDescription: Which completion backends appear in the GhostPrompt model dropdown and receive routed requests. Include **`copilot`** for GitHub Copilot LM (`vscode.lm`) and **`opencode`** for the embedded OpenCode server. Example: `["copilot", "opencode"]` lists **both**; GhostPrompt routes by selected model id (`provider/model` → OpenCode). If this array is **unset** in settings (never saved), GhostPrompt keeps using **completionProvider** for backward compatibility.

ghostPrompt.opencodeExcludedModelIds.markdownDescription: OpenCode models to hide from the GhostPrompt dropdown. Use ids `providerID/modelID` (same as OpenCode). Ignored when completion provider is Copilot.

ghostPrompt.suggestionModelPolicy.markdownDescription: Policy to choose Copilot model for inline suggestions. `nonPremiumOnly` (safe default) uses only included (`0x`) models when metadata is available; `anyModel` allows first available model and may consume premium quota.

ghostPrompt.selectedModelId.markdownDescription: Preferred model id for inline suggestions. Use `auto` for automatic selection. With OpenCode, ids are `providerID/modelID`; the dropdown lists available models when the OpenCode runtime is running.

ghostPrompt.debugSuggestions.markdownDescription: Enable structured debug logs for suggestion lifecycle in the `GhostPrompt Suggestions` output channel.

ghostPrompt.maxSuggestionChars.markdownDescription: Maximum number of characters for each inline suggestion after normalization.

ghostPrompt.suggestionStyle.markdownDescription: Controls how specific and long inline suggestions should be. `concise` keeps short continuations, `balanced` keeps practical context-rich responses, `detailed` allows richer multi-sentence continuations.

ghostPrompt.contextMode.markdownDescription: Controls whether context is used to shape inline suggestions. `off` disables context, `basic` uses recent session prompt/suggestion signals, `project` also includes lightweight active workspace/file context.

ghostPrompt.suggestionLanguageMode.markdownDescription: Language mode for suggestions. `auto` detects language from current input, `manual` forces the configured suggestion language.

ghostPrompt.suggestionLanguage.markdownDescription: Suggestion output language used when `ghostPrompt.suggestionLanguageMode` is `manual`.

ghostPrompt.minCharsForSuggestion.markdownDescription: Minimum normalized character count required before requesting a suggestion.

ghostPrompt.requestCooldownMs.markdownDescription: Minimum cooldown between repeated identical suggestion inputs.

ghostPrompt.cacheTtlMs.markdownDescription: How long suggestion cache entries are kept in memory (milliseconds).

ghostPrompt.rateLimitMaxRequests.markdownDescription: Maximum suggestion requests allowed within the configured rate limit window.

ghostPrompt.rateLimitWindowMs.markdownDescription: Window size in milliseconds used by rate limiting.

ghostPrompt.sessionRequestBudget.markdownDescription: Maximum number of suggestion model requests allowed per extension session.

ghostPrompt.projectMemoryUnusedStoreTtlD.markdownDescription: Days since last GhostPrompt activity before **deleting on-disk project memory** for that workspace root (`registry.json` + `stores/` under extension global storage). Open workspace folders refresh `lastSeenAt` during extension activation.

ghostPrompt.projectMemoryEnabled.markdownDescription: When **true**, GhostPrompt **persists validated bootstrap excerpts** (`README*` / `package.json`) under extension global storage when `contextMode` is **project** and a real LM request runs (see roadmap v0.4 phase C).

ghostPrompt.projectMemoryEditorIngestEna.markdownDescription: Requires **projectMemoryEnabled**. When **true**, GhostPrompt **indexes short excerpts** from workspace files you focus in the editor (filtered by extension/size) into project memory and may include them in **project** mode suggestions (phase D).

ghostPrompt.projectMemoryMaxTotalBytes.markdownDescription: Soft cap on **serialized size** of **editor-ingest** entries per workspace root before LRU eviction (bytes).

ghostPrompt.projectMemoryMaxEntryBytes.markdownDescription: Maximum **raw file bytes** read from disk when indexing an editor-ingest excerpt (truncated UTF-8).

ghostPrompt.projectMemoryMaxEditorSource.markdownDescription: Maximum number of **editor-ingest** entries kept per workspace before LRU eviction.

ghostPrompt.projectMemoryEditorMaxFileBy.markdownDescription: Skip indexing files larger than this many bytes (stat size).

ghostPrompt.projectMemoryEditorAllowedEx.markdownDescription: Comma-separated **file extensions** (with leading `.`) eligible for editor-ingest.

ghostPrompt.projectMemoryEditorPathExclu.markdownDescription: Optional extra path fragments or simple patterns (best-effort; always excludes `node_modules`, `.git`, and `.env*` segments).

ghostPrompt.projectMemoryFileWatcherEnab.markdownDescription: When **true**, GhostPrompt watches **only indexed file paths** (from project memory) for changes/deletes and removes stale entries proactively (phase E). Disabling avoids extra file watchers (lower background activity). Requires **projectMemoryEnabled**.

ghostPrompt.projectMemoryFileWatcherThro.markdownDescription: Debounce for grouping filesystem invalidation events from **projectMemoryFileWatcherEnabled** (milliseconds).

scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm run deps:circular && npm run compile && npm run typecheck:webview && npm run build:webview && npm run verify:webview-bundle
scripts.check: npm run validate && npm run test
scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run build:webview && npm run compile
